Suppose that the matrix $A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} \vvec_1 \amp \vvec_2 \end{array}\right] $ where $\vvec_1$ and $\vvec_2$ are shown in [ex-eq-graphical].

Two vectors $\vvec_1$ and $\vvec_2$ that form the columns of the matrix $A$.

What is the shape of the matrix $A$?

On [ex-eq-graphical], indicate the vectors $$ A\twovec{1}{0}, ~~~A\twovec{2}{3}, ~~~A\twovec{0}{-3} $$ .

Find all vectors $\xvec$ such that $A\xvec=\bvec$.

Find all vectors $\xvec$ such that $A\xvec = \zerovec$.
